How do you get a good grade under NQH?
-> Attend all the classes with utmost concentration (Never miss a class). Listen to his analogies and try to make notes of those. If you follow these suggestions, you will easily get a good mark in the exams, and if you can outperform most of the students in the section, you can hope to get a good grade.
